annotations.title: Real-Time Google Search Grounded JSON Market Intelligence Brief

description: Synthesizes a real-time market or technical intelligence brief grounded in live Google Search, returning strict JSON ('executive_summary', 'key_developments', 'sentiment', 'sources'). Use when fetching a structured JSON market/news brief with live web citations and sentiment classification; for summarizing caller-supplied text offline without live web search, use summarize_technical_document instead. Read-only edge call (32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'topic' ('focus' defaults to 'technical_and_market_catalysts'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (200 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

focus.description: Analytical angle applied to the brief; defaults to 'technical_and_market_catalysts' when omitted.

topic.description: Company, protocol, market sector, or technical topic to brief.

name: synthesize_web_intelligence_brief

key_developments.description: Dated factual developments grounded in search results.

sources.description: Verified web source titles and URLs.

title: Real-Time Google Search Grounded JSON Market Intelligence Brief
